name: Env Setup
description: Categorised .env.example, Zod runtime validation, check-env script, and SETUP.md first-day guide

questions.prompt: Fail hard at startup if required env vars are missing?

checklist: Ensure .gitignore ignores .env.local and .env.*.local (and does NOT ignore .env.example) — never commit real secrets
cp .env.example .env.local, then set every variable annotated # required (here and in any .env.<template>.example)
Add a script to package.json: "check:env": "tsx scripts/check-env.ts"
npm run check:env  ← validates .env.local before first run / demo / deploy
Server code imports { serverEnv } from src/config/env.server; client code imports { clientEnv } from src/config/env.client (the src/config/env barrel re-exports types only)
Read SETUP.md for the env model (server vs client split, strict validation)
